results.title: Jireh Gospel: Hearts in Chorus
results.original_title: Jireh Gospel, une famille de chœur
results.overview: Jireh Gospel: Hearts in Chorus is an intimate and uplifting portrait of Montreal’s celebrated choir. Directed by Wylem Decaille, the film follows the ensemble as they prepare for their Christmas concert, revealing the group’s passion and commitment. Through soulful performances and candid moments, it celebrates gospel music as an act of faith and community that can transform hearts, heal the soul and inspire joy.

results.title: Qaitadan
results.overview: After graduating from school, Rawan witnesses a tragedy when a dam breach causes the death of all the villagers. However, unexpectedly, the young man is given a second chance. But will he be able to use it to prevent the catastrophe?

results.title: American Wages
results.overview: One day, a struggling couple, Jack and Ashley, notice a truck stopped in their driveway with a dying man and duffel bags filled with a life changing amount of cash, leading them to grapple with moral dilemmas and dangerous consequences as they attempt to change their lives. Their decision to keep the money intertwines their fate with the suspicions of Sheriff Dolion and the menacing forces of the local criminal underworld, escalating tensions and jeopardizing their dreams of a better future.

results.title: The Wickywock and the JubJub Berry
results.original_title: The Wickywock and the JubJub Berry
results.overview: In a woodland glade, an exhausted mythical creature is suffering from insomnia. When a small, verbose forest sprite appears and offers a sedative, it sounds like a perfect solution but the fatigued Wickywock is too impatient to heed the Sprite’s terms.

results.title: Cherub
results.overview: A Cherub delivers a message from God through an ultrasound

results.title: Fans Only 2: Dreams Fame Desire
results.overview: As the journey continues, the documentary dives deeper into the private lives of adult performers. Through honest interviews, it reveals the emotional pressure and humanity behind an industry many think they already understand.

results.title: Perfect Family
results.overview: Siew Bong is, with respect, quite an average person. He’s unexceptional in anything and has not achieved much, which typically isn’t a problem until he has to meet his girlfriend’s ultra-rich, ultra-high-achieving family that believes in flawlessness as the highest form of human value, a value especially upheld and enforced by the tyrannical matriarch of the family, Antoinette. Things turn south over a family dinner when Siew Bong’s beliefs on a person’s value grinds against the family’s facade of perfectionism.

results.title: Caravan
results.overview: Overwhelmed by motherhood, Ester steals a caravan and flees to southern Italy with her son David, with an intellectual disability. They meet a young drifter whose open heart transforms their makeshift family into something freer, lighter, and full of unexpected hope.

results.title: The Agenda: Their Vision – Your Future
results.original_title: The Agenda: Their Vision – Your Future
results.overview: The Agenda: Their Vision – Your Future is a feature-length independent documentary by former UK broadcasting executive Mark Sharman (ITV, Sky). It explores claims of a decades-long plan by global elites to centralize control using tools like AI, surveillance, digital currencies, and digital identities. The film warns of a "digital prison" where everyday freedoms—food, energy, money, travel, internet access—could be restricted. It questions the role of institutions like the WHO and critiques the UN's Agenda 2030 and Net Zero goals as potential enablers of global authoritarianism. Featuring expert voices from the UK, USA, and Europe, the documentary draws parallels with dystopian visions from Orwell and Huxley.

results.title: Adult
results.overview: Fourteen-year-old Antonio was living with his father when suddenly one day his father didn't come home and didn't respond to his messages or phone calls. Antonio learns from a neighbor that his father has been hospitalized due to a motorcycle accident, and since then he has had to cope with life on his own; in addition to studying for schoolwork and feeding himself, he also has to spend money on fixing his car....... It is not easy to get through to the day when his father is released from the hospital, and Antonio discovers that his father has gone to the police station, and it turns out that the car accident has another hidden agenda...

results.title: Ponyboi
results.overview: Unfolding over the course of Valentine’s Day in New Jersey, a young intersex sex worker must run from the mob after a drug deal goes sideways, forcing him to confront his past.

results.title: Mystery Island: Winner Takes All
results.overview: Mystery Island hosts contest winners vying to solve a fake murder for a grand prize, but the event goes awry when an employee is murdered, and secrets are uncovered.

results.title: The Trouble with Declan
results.overview: After his work gets rejected, a struggling writer finds inspiration in a Bible study group under the guidance of the cryptic Pastor Johnson. What begins as a creative revival slowly twists into something far more mysterious and dangerous.

results.title: Hacia dónde vamos
results.overview: Rosa is a wheelchair user who has just started a new job. However, her inexperience irritates both her colleagues and her boss. This causes her distress because Rosa doesn't know if this rejection is due to her lack of experience or her condition. One night, Rosa meets Puri who, with her kindness and willingness to listen, helps her see something within herself that will change her life.

results.title: It's a Trap
results.overview: Tiunai is a wannabe party boy with one goal—to hit the scene in style and catch the eye of the right girl for a night to remember. Armed with his older brother’s advice and the swagger he picks up from his favorite Trap tracks, he’s ready to prove he’s *that* guy—cool, confident, and effortlessly smooth. But in the pursuit of the perfect night, things don’t always go as planned.
